moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio anticipation, written here): Recipe: pull back ~8 px the opposite way in 100 ms (ease-out), then go to the target by 400 ms (expo.out); for a button, scale 0.95 → 1. Site demo: a square pulls back 16 px in 350 ms, then dashes 218 px in 300 ms (power2.inOut keys), scaleX −10 % during the pull-back and +25 % during the dash (scaleY = 1/scaleX, sine bumps). Rule: 10–20 % of the main move's length and amount. Params: pull (8 px) · pull_time (0.1 s) · duration (0.4 s) · ease đi (expo.out). The recipe: about 8 px back in 0.1 s, then to the target by 0.4 s expo.out; a button scales 0.95 → 1.
